current_usefulness.material_inspected: Complete current printed abstract reread after all six gates passed. Actual article front matter and source/method sections were separately checked for identity and taxonomy-source support; no full scientific critique.
current_usefulness.present_day_application: A concrete example of automating initial classification of cybercrime complaint narratives; word-based features and supervised classifiers remain transferable methods for triage design.
current_usefulness.limitations: Three jurisdiction-specific legal categories. Dataset quality, out-of-sample performance, fairness and present legal applicability have not been independently validated. Human investigative/legal judgment remains necessary; publication year alone establishes neither current law nor effectiveness.
